Human strategy and AI adoption go hand in hand
For the past few years, much of the conversation around AI has centered on capability. We have watched it move from generating content and summarizing information to analyzing data, writing code and completing increasingly complex tasks. Now, with the rapid development of AI agents, we are beginning to hand over not just tasks, but portions of workflows and decisions as well.
President at ContinuumGlobal.
That progression has understandably raised questions about what happens to people as AI becomes more autonomous, but we are looking at that question the wrong way. The bigger change will be in what we need people to do. When AI tools can handle more of the execution, people have to spend more time thinking about the system around it. We need to ask ourselves important questions to do this:
- What are we actually trying to accomplish?
- What information does the technology need to make a good decision?
- How should work move from one step to another?
- When can AI make a decision on its own, and when does someone need to get involved?
These are questions companies already deal with today, but AI raises the stakes because decisions and actions can happen much faster and at a much greater scale. Take a marketing organization as an example.

articles.title: What Does It Really Mean To Program With AI: A Conversation with Joy Ebertz
articles.summary:
In this podcast, Michael Stiefel spoke to Joy Ebertz about how the use of artificial intelligence is changing the way architects and developers do their jobs. Focusing on the long term success of the business is one of the most neglected tasks of an architect. This task becomes particularly important as the nature of artificial intelligence changes the landscape of software development. Architects must be especially aware of requirements and their inherent ambiguity. More than ever, they must be expert at explaining technology to the business people, and the business to the technology people. On the flip side, goals must be clearly explained to AI agents, and tests must be unambiguously written. Industry practice is uncertain on how to incorporate changes due to bug reports or new requirements. Should it be done incrementally, or should the module’s or application’s code base be regenerated? This is especially challenging in existing systems, especially old ones where nobody knows what the real requirements were. Unambiguous requirements definition may turn out to be the gating factor in AI driven software development because code reviews seem not to be effective, and verification of the AI work is a great burden.
The conversation then shifted to talk about the future of software developers. The industry needs to find a way to use AI so that human understanding of how software systems work does not atrophy. The flexibility that AI coding gives you reinforces the idea that con…

articles.title: African AI startups need more than prompts to win VC money
articles.summary:
Artificial intelligence (AI) has reshaped how the world works, and African AI startups, venture capital and tech ecosystems are no exception. The technology is evolving so fast that many investors are still working out how to evaluate AI startups, let alone how to fund them.
Over the past six months, this column has spoken to African investors across regions, sectors, and funding stages about where AI creates genuine value, where it falls short, and what merits institutional capital.
They are Babacar Seck, founder of Askya Investment Partners; Eloho Omame, partner at TLcom Capital; Emmanuel Adegboye, head of Madica; Magnifique Ishimwe, fund manager at the Development Bank of Rwanda; Husein Merchant, investment officer at Village Capital; and Benjamin Toulouze, head of corporate venture capital at AXIAN Investment.
When we asked them what makes an AI startup fundable, they mostly described something an AI model itself cannot supply. Anyone can build on the same foundational models now, so investors are paying for what sits around them: voice products that work in Wolof and isiZulu, software tied so deeply into a customer’s systems that leaving is painful, licences that take years to win, and revenue.

articles.summary:
La inteligencia artificial y todo lo que se mueve en torno a ella se ha convertido en una gran promesa en la que las big tech están vertiendo enormes cantidades de dinero. Y en el caso de Estados Unidos, la economía es cada vez más dependiente de la IA. Un dato: el gasto en centros de datos, hardware y redes ya supone el 0,8% de su PIB en el primer trimestre del año, según datos de Epoch AI.
Parte de esa inversión en datacenters y cálculo es física: infraestructuras y edificios que alguien tiene que construir. Y si el PIB ya evidencia el peso de la IA en la economía estadounidense, la construcción es una auténtica bofetada de realidad.
Esa obra es un centro de datos. El inversor y periodista económico Steve Rattner ha elaborado un gráfico con los datos del U.S. Census Bureau que lo ilustra bien: mientras el conjunto del resto de la construcción privada retrocede, el gasto en centros de datos sigue creciendo.
Desde diciembre de 2023, el gasto en construir centros de datos ha pasado de unos 24.000 millones de dólares a más de 75.000 millones al año en julio de 2026: unos 51.000 millones más. Mientras, en ese mismo periodo el gasto en construir todo lo demás bajó 120.000 millones. Desde 2024, el Census Bureau muestra con todo el sentido del mundo los centros de datos por separado dentro de la construcción de oficinas porque unidos, distorsionan la imagen del sector.

Coder creates NvidiaWatch tracker site that monitors hundreds of GPU driver bugs — site charts open issues, fixes, and forum feedback across updates
This page aggregates Nvidia's driver updates to make issues easier to track.
A GitHub programmer has created an Nvidia bug tracker page that compiles each driver update’s release notes and feedback threads on the forums, logging progress on 462 different driver bugs. They first shared their creation, called NvidiaWatch, in late September and then released an update on the r/Nvidia subreddit earlier this week.
The programmer said that each bug gets its own page, meaning anyone affected by it could easily track if the latest driver update has already solved the issue. Each driver update also gets a dedicated page that includes the release notes, fixed bugs, and open issues that Nvidia couldn’t address yet. The creator also added a chart that tracks the number of known issues that were fixed during that release, fixed in a later release, remained open, and those that were carried over from an earlier driver release.
This website is quite useful for anyone running into issues with their Nvidia hardware, as they’d be able to track whether their problem has already been recognized by the company and whether it has done something about it. AMD RDNA 5 Likely Scheduled for Second Half of 2027
AMD's next-generation gaming graphics cards featuring the RDNA 5 GPU architecture are unlikely to debut before the second half of 2027, according to well-known hardware leaker Kepler_L2. This will be followed by "AT0," "AT3," and "AT4," which are expected to launch a few quarters later in 2028. Since "AT2" likely refers to a mid-range design, AMD might begin its rollout with a mid-range GPU first, followed by flagship and lower-end models in 2028.
Previously, we learned that AMD's RDNA 5 GPUs will incorporate GDDR7 memory with unknown capacities, as GDDR7 is now listed among the supported VRAM types in the AMDGPU driver. Currently, AMD's graphics cards use GDDR6 for the consumer RDNA 4-based Radeon RX 9000 series, while Instinct MI data center and workstation GPUs use HBM3E and HBM4 memory. articles.title: When Should You Use Liquid Clustering? Benchmarking Lakehouse Layout Strategies
articles.summary:
Key Takeaways
- No single storage layout is universally optimal for lakehouse analytics: The right choice is workload-dependent, because using Liquid Clustering, ZOrder, or Partitioning incorrectly can materially impact cost and latency.
- ZOrder has a hidden failure mode. When a date column appears as a secondary or tertiary clustering key, time range queries perform significantly worse than on a simple date-partitioned table.
- Bytes scanned is a misleading performance proxy. Liquid Clustering delivers the lowest latency on point lookups despite scanning more raw data than ZOrder.
- Liquid Clustering should be the default for any team whose query patterns are diverse or evolving and outperforms ZOrder on most workloads while eliminating the operational burden of manual OPTIMIZE jobs and periodic full table rewrites.
- Before finalizing any layout strategy, ask yourself: ”Do my top queries consistently filter on the same two or three columns? If the answer is yes, ZOrder those columns. Otherwise, choose Liquid Clustering.

No single storage layout is universally optimal for lakehouse analytical systems. Across four workload types benchmarked on Delta Lake, Liquid Clustering delivers the lowest latency for point lookups, time-range aggregations, and large aggregations. articles.title: Francia ya ha tenido 800 horas de electricidad gratis (y hasta de precio negativo) por estos motivos

Y no son los únicos. El auge de las energías renovables, especialmente de la solar, está haciendo que, en determinadas horas, la oferta de electricidad supere ampliamente a la demanda. El resultado de esto suele ser que los precios de la electricidad caigan por debajo de cero con una frecuencia cada vez mayor. En Francia, esto ya ha ocurrido durante 800 horas este año, pero otros países como Suecia, Países Bajos o España también están registrando periodos negativos. ¿Por qué está ocurriendo y qué consecuencias tiene para el sistema eléctrico?
¿Por qué se están produciendo precios negativos? Le Réseau de Transport d’Électricité (RTE) explica en su página web que en el mercado mayorista de electricidad los proveedores compran electricidad a un precio calculado, en este caso cada cuarto de hora, según la oferta y la demanda. A ese precio se le conoce como precio spot y, a nivel europeo, este sistema sigue un modelo de precios marginales. Esto significa que el precio de la última central eléctrica que se utiliza para abastecer la demanda es el que determina el precio para todas las demás.
Cuando la producción supera al consumo y no hay suficiente flexibilidad para absorber el excedente, el precio mayorista del megavatio-hora puede caer por debajo de cero. En ese escenario, algunos productores pueden llegar a aceptar precios negativos, es decir, acceden a pagar por cada MWh que venden al mercado. Artemis II despegó el 1 de abril con cuatro tripulantes a bordo de la cápsula Orion y sobrevoló la Luna el día 6, acercándose hasta unos 4.067 millas (6.545 kilómetros) de la superficie antes de regresar y amarizar frente a la costa de San Diego. articles.summary:
CEOs say AI is helping their businesses be more productive — even if they're not always sure what's going on
AI is boosting productivity – but we need metrics
- AI named as one of the three biggest factors to boost productivity
- Visibility over costs and ROI falls short, study finds
- Legacy tech and skills gaps are ongoing issues
Over half (50%) UK CEOs have credited AI with being one of the three biggest contributors to their productivity improvements over the past year, ranking ahead of more traditional aids like redesigning and simplifying business processes (40%) and reselling workers (38%).
But despite naming AI as one of the biggest influencers on productivity, business leaders aren't exactly sure how it's helping, and only 14% of UK CEOs have full real-time visibility over their AI costs, a new EY report has claimed.
As such, one in three (32%) say they're unable to properly asses AI's ROI, making it difficult for them to actually know whether its impacts are translating into financial value.
AI is probably boosting productivity, but we don't really know how
"UK CEOs now want clear evidence that their investment is delivering stronger productivity and measurable business value," UK&I Managing Partner Silvia Rindone explained, implying that companies need greater visibility across their AI spend and impacts.
However, it's not just difficulties quantifying ROI that's helping non-adopters back when it comes to AI. Legacy systems (34%) and organizational complexity (29%)…

articles.title: Bill Gates prevé ciberataques con IA el próximo año: “Serán el desafío más destacable”
articles.summary:
Bill Gates advirtió que el próximo año estará marcado por una multiplicación de los ciberataques impulsados por inteligencia artificial. El cofundador de Microsoft señaló que ese riesgo, y no la posibilidad de que la tecnología se torne “incontrolable”, representa la amenaza inmediata más urgente para la seguridad global.
Las declaraciones se dieron el domingo durante una entrevista en el canal estadounidense ABC News, semanas después de que Gates ya hubiera alertado sobre la falta de preparación del mundo frente a las consecuencias de la inteligencia artificial.
Ciberseguridad y riesgos de la inteligencia artificial en 2027
Gates fue categórico al describir el panorama que se avecina. “Los ciberataques serán sin duda el desafío más destacable al que nos enfrentaremos en el próximo año”, declaró el empresario durante la entrevista.
El cofundador de Microsoft diferenció entre dos tipos de amenazas vinculadas a la inteligencia artificial. Por un lado, descartó que el peligro inminente sea la pérdida de control sobre la tecnología, aunque reconoció que ese frente “habrá que trabajar en ello” a futuro.
Por otro lado, ubicó el riesgo real en el uso malintencionado de estas herramientas. “El verdadero peligro, en este momento, no es que la IA se vuelva incontrolable”, sino “más bien que personas malintencionadas la utilicen”, explicó.

articles.title: Spotify More Than Doubled Monthly Code Changes as AI Accelerated Development
articles.summary:
Spotify has expanded its use of AI-assisted development, more than doubling monthly merged changes from approximately 8,100 to 17,000 year over year in August. The company is adapting its quality and reliability controls to handle the higher volume of software changes across its production systems.
Spotify operates nearly 3,000 production services supporting 777 million monthly active users, around 100 million concurrent clients, and 11 to 12 million backend requests per second. Its review identified issues involving content processing, fleet changes, compute capacity, and mobile application quality. The company has responded with changes to monitoring, testing, rollout safeguards, rollback capacity, capacity planning, and quality measurement.
One incident involved Spotify's content processing pipeline, which handles more than 500,000 new songs, videos, podcasts, and audiobooks each day. On June 24, a scheduled batch workload competed with new episodes, a quality improvement increased processing requirements, and a scheduling bug reduced throughput by about 10%. Episodes that normally appeared within minutes were delayed for hours. Spotify subsequently added end-to-end monitoring, fixed the scheduler, moved batch jobs to lower priority, reworked workload prioritization, and increased capacity.

articles.title: Ledger confirme un implant espion dans un portefeuille vendu par son propre revendeur agréé — Frandroid
articles.summary:
Ledger, le fabricant français qui domine le marché des portefeuilles physiques pour cryptomonnaies, a dû admettre ce que ses clients redoutent le plus.
Dans un message publié sur X le samedi 10 octobre, son support explique que l’appareil d’une victime contenait « un implant matériel non autorisé ». Toutes les victimes connues avaient acheté leur portefeuille chez CryptoBilis, un revendeur agréé présent en Indonésie, en Malaisie et aux Philippines.
Des chercheurs qui suivent les transactions sur la blockchain estiment que 86 à 93 millions de dollars ont été volés, soit environ 77 à 83 millions d’euros, dans plus de 300 portefeuilles, d’après CoinDesk. De son côté, Ledger n’a confirmé aucun montant. La marque juge « limité » le nombre d’appareils touchés.
Ce type d’appareil sert justement à empêcher ce genre de vol. Un portefeuille physique ressemble à une clé USB et garde hors ligne les clés privées, ces codes secrets qui permettent de dépenser des cryptomonnaies. À la première mise en route, il affiche une phrase de récupération de 24 mots. Toute personne qui connaît ces mots a accès aux fonds.
Un mouchard qui passe le contrôle d’authenticité
Ledger n’a pas décrit l’implant. Mark Karpelès, l’ancien patron de Mt.Gox (la plateforme d’échange de bitcoins qui a fait faillite en 2014), a publié sur X des photos d’un Ledger Nano X démonté qui contient un composant suspect. D’après son analyse, ce composant lit les données envoyées à l’écran et transmet les 24 mots vers l’extérieur…

articles.title: IndianRaga founder Sriram Emani explores identity and belonging in Jam Boy
articles.summary:
IndianRaga founder Sriram Emani explores identity and belonging in Jam Boy
After building IndianRaga into a global platform for Indian performing arts, Sriram Emani is turning to filmmaking to tell nuanced South Asian stories that challenge familiar stereotypes.
Sriram Emani, the founder of IndianRaga, a global platform for Indian performing arts, has an album on Facebook showcasing all the cups he’s collected from different Starbucks outlets in New York. Each of the 74 images shows his name being misspelt.
“It’s one of the most common names on the planet. But it was still spelt as ‘Syrian’, ‘Shadam’; not a single person got it right. If you can say Schwarzenegger, Saoirse Ronan, you can say Sriram,” says Emani.
This frustrating experience, commonly faced by immigrants, planted the seeds for Jam Boy, Emani’s first film as a writer, director, co-producer and lead actor.
Jam Boy is about a model immigrant who has done everything to be chosen but has not noticed what it costs him to choose himself.
Spanning 22 minutes 22 seconds, the film has already won Best Film and Best Web Series at DC Independent Film Festival, received Special Recognition at the Boston International Film Festival, and is now travelling through a growing international festival run. It will premiere on October 13 at the International Film Festival of South Asia, Toronto, North America's largest South Asian film festival.

articles.title: Das Ende von Photoshop, Word & Co.? So schlagen sich KI-generierte Software-Kopien wirklich
articles.summary:
Das Ende von Photoshop, Word & Co.? So schlagen sich KI-generierte Software-Kopien wirklich
„Software is over“, erklärte der US-amerikanische Entwickler Brandon Thomas Anfang Oktober 2026 im Online-Forum Hacker News. Wie als Beleg für diese These veröffentlichte Thomas nicht weniger als KI-generierte Kopien aller wichtigen Adobe-Programme. Darunter Photoshop, Lightroom, Illustrator, Premiere und Indesign.
Alle Programme sind gratis, Open Source und wurden mithilfe von Anthropics Opus-Modellen entwickelt. Als wäre das noch nicht genug, folgten seitdem auch KI-Kopien von den Microsoft-Produkten Word, Excel und Powerpoint, sowie der Programme Autodesk AutoCAD und Avid Pro Tools.
Damit bietet Thomas‘ Artcraft-Projekt mittlerweile Klone kommerzieller Produkte an, die bei einer Vielzahl von Firmen den Arbeitsalltag bestimmen. Und zwar in Versionen für Windows, Linux und macOS. Aber können die Kopien im Alltag wirklich überzeugen?

articles.title: Orange transforme le téléphone de ses abonnés en roue de secours quand la fibre tombe en panne
articles.summary:
Orange vient de lancer Reconnexion Flash, un service de la Livebox qui bascule sur le partage de connexion d’un smartphone en cas de panne internet. Une réponse aux coupures de fibre sans boîtier, pendant que la concurrence mise sur des box de secours.
Une panne de fibre, par définition, ne prévient jamais, voilà pourquoi Orange a dévoilé ce lundi 12 octobre Reconnexion Flash. Il s'agit d'une solution de secours en cas de panne de fibre optique, solution directement intégrée à la Livebox. Le principe repose sur un smartphone présent dans le logement, dont le partage de connexion permet de remettre en ligne l’ensemble des appareils de la maison en quelques minutes. L’opérateur historique s’invite ainsi sur un terrain déjà occupé par ses concurrents, mais avec une approche sensiblement différente.
Reconnexion Flash : un QR code et la Livebox d'Orange repart
Le dispositif Reconnaissance Flash a été pensé par Orange pour les moments où l'on n'a pas envie de réfléchir. Dès qu'elle détecte une coupure, la Livebox suggère d'elle-même d'activer Reconnexion Flash et affiche un QR code sur son écran. Un coup de téléphone portable, et une page web explique pas à pas comment lancer le partage de connexion. La box s'y raccroche ensuite toute seule. En quelques minutes, la connexion est rétablie.

articles.title: When one robot learns, every robot knows if they can communicate
articles.summary:
When one robot learns, every robot knows if they can communicate
The fastest way to transfer robot data in 2026 is still a person walking
The robots are among us. They’re carrying passengers through the streets of San Francisco, delivering parcels over the air, and working their way across farms, factories, mines, and industrial sites.
The collision we’re now witnessing between artificial intelligence and the physical world is often described as “Physical AI” – machines capable of perceiving their surroundings, making decisions, and taking action among us in the real world. But every new machine that clocks in has a second job we rarely see. It creates data. Lots of it.
Founder and CEO of Taara.
In the US, the Federal Aviation Administration expects the commercial drone fleet to grow from approximately 966,000 aircraft at the end of 2024 to around 1.18 million by 2029. And in factories around the world, there was an estimated 4.66 million industrial robots working in 2024, while another half a million were installed during the year – more than twice the number installed a decade earlier.
Today’s autonomous machines are vastly more capable, but moving all that accumulated experience off them can still be surprisingly manual. In 2026, the fastest way to move masses of data off a machine is still a person carrying a hard drive. And as autonomous machines spread further into our cities and industries, keeping that information moving could become one of the defining infrastructure…

articles.title: Votre PC Windows pourrait être privé de mise à jour en 2027, mais il y a un moyen d'éviter ça
articles.summary:
À partir du 17 mai ou du 19 juin 2027 (selon la version), votre PC sous Windows pourrait ne plus pouvoir se mettre à jour. Cela concerne les machines qui n’auront pas reçu les nouveaux certificats de Windows Update. Le moyen le plus facile d’éviter cette infortune : mettre à jour votre ordinateur.
Windows Update a besoin d’un certificat pour continuer à mettre à jour votre PC Windows
Windows Update utilise des certificats numériques pour vérifier qu’un PC communique bien avec les serveurs officiels de Microsoft. Cependant, certains d’entre eux doivent expirer le 17 mai 2027 et le 19 juin 2027, comme l’a rappelé le blog de Microsoft dédié aux administrateurs réseau. Leurs remplaçants sont bien intégrés aux mises à jour mensuelles de Windows : un appareil qui reçoit les correctifs nécessaires à temps devrait donc conserver l’accès à Windows Update.
Rassurez-vous, si les certificats de votre ordinateur ne sont pas renouvelés, vous pourrez quand même l’utiliser. Mais il ne pourra plus recevoir les mises à jour de sécurité, les correctifs de fiabilité et autres mises à jours de Windows proposés via Windows Update. Plus le temps avancera, plus le risque d’être visé par une vulnérabilité nouvellement découverte augmentera. Dans le cas où Windows Update ne proposerait pas le correctif, Microsoft précise qu’il peut être téléchargé depuis le Catalogue Microsoft Update.

articles.title: After a 10-year redemption arc, No Man's Sky is coming to the iPhone and iPad
articles.summary:
Just over 10 years after its initial release, space exploration and survival crafting game No Man’s Sky is making its way to the iPhone and iPad, Apple and developer Hello Games announced today.
It will run on devices as far back as the iPhone 11 and the third-generation iPad Air. No Man’s Sky might not have the most cutting-edge AAA graphics (though they’re still strong, and they’ve come a long way since launch via updates), but the game’s uncommon method of generating galaxies of incomprehensible scale on device consistently for all players from a single-seed happening on a phone is remarkable for those of us who remember phones performing far behind consoles or desktop PCs.
This version of the game includes all of the content and systems updates to the game that have been added over the years—the expansions that famously took the game from a rocky launch reception to a widely beloved redemption story.
There are a couple of compromises, though, and it’s similar to what we saw with No Man’s Sky on the Nintendo Switch. Hello Games says the ability to build and explore player-made planetary settlements is limited to the iPhone 15 Pro and later, and multiplayer is not supported on any iOS device. “We are excited to see player feedback on iOS, and will support it appropriately based on how many folks are playing,” the company says, leaving the door open to perhaps not supporting all future content updates if the player base isn’t there to justify it.

articles.title: GTA VI vs. Zelda Ocarina of Time: exproductor de Fortnite afirma que solo Nintendo puede desafiar a Rockstar
articles.summary:
GTA VI se acerca como uno de los lanzamientos más esperados en la historia de los videojuegos, y su sola presencia en el calendario ha bastado para que buena parte de la industria reacomode sus propios estrenos. Sin embargo, Nintendo rompió con esa tendencia: mantuvo la fecha de The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time a solo dos semanas del debut de Rockstar.
Para Aakash Gupta, especialista en estrategia de producto y crecimiento que trabajó en Epic Games, esa decisión confirma que Nintendo es la única compañía capaz de sostener su terreno frente al fenómeno que representa GTA VI.
Por qué Nintendo no movió el lanzamiento de Zelda
Gupta comparó el panorama de estrenos con un “juego de gallina”: cuando un proyecto de la magnitud de GTA VI toma una fecha, el resto de las compañías deben elegir entre sostenerse o apartarse para no quedar eclipsadas.
Según su lectura, casi toda la industria optó por correrse del camino de Rockstar para evitar competir por la atención del público. Nintendo fue la excepción y decidió avanzar con el lanzamiento de su remake sin modificar el calendario original.
“Son la única compañía en la industria con una base de fans lo suficientemente leal para hacer esa apuesta”, afirmó Gupta.

articles.title: This AI startup says it can generate permit-ready blueprints in minutes | TechCrunch
articles.summary:
Nearly two decades ago, a young college student wrote his final thesis about software capable of generating design documents for school buildings. Al Dram was studying architecture — following in the footsteps of his parents and grandfather — but it was technology that really intrigued him.
There was just one problem: The technology his idea required didn’t exist yet.
“Then ChatGPT came along,” said Dram, recalling when OpenAI released the generative AI chatbot that uses large language models (LLMs) in November 2022.
His old idea suddenly seemed a lot more possible. Within six months, he launched the concept of Blueprints AI, a startup that uses AI to produce code-compliant and permit-ready architectural construction blueprints in minutes from a 2D sketch or PDF.

Tout part de deux jugements du 17 avril lorsque le tribunal avait ordonné à Cloudflare de bloquer l’accès depuis la France à 21 noms de domaine diffusant la F1, jusqu’à la dernière course du 6 décembre, et à 16 autres pour le MotoGP, jusqu’au 22 novembre. Un blocage par le CDN, pas par le DNS
Cloudflare a agi par son seul CDN, le service qui relaie et protège les sites : un site pirate client de ce service devient inaccessible en France. Elle n’a rien fait via 1.1.1.1, son résolveur DNS public, une sorte d’annuaire du web. Selon Canal+, deux des trois sites bloqués étaient de nouveau accessibles une semaine plus tard, l’un après un changement de CDN, l’autre via un site miroir.
Le tribunal ne tranche pas la question du DNS et relève simplement que Cloudflare soutient que l’architecture de 1.1.1.1 ne permet pas de bloquer, et que ce serait déraisonnable. articles.title: Intel to phase out SGX after Xeon Diamond Rapids in favor of TDX — confidential computing pivot adds trusted I/O and post-quantum crypto for agentic AI
articles.summary:
Intel to phase out SGX after Xeon Diamond Rapids in favor of TDX — confidential computing pivot adds trusted I/O and post-quantum crypto for agentic AI
Diamond Rapids last to support SGX.
Just five years after bringing its Software Guard Extensions (SGX) technology to its mainstream server platform, Intel on Friday announced plans to discontinue its support after its upcoming Xeon 'Diamond Rapids' CPUs and concentrate its confidential computing efforts on Trust Domain Extensions (TDX). The company will continue to support existing SGX-enabled platforms into the early 2030s, but at the same time will expand TDX capabilities to address emerging requirements of cloud computing, enterprise workloads, and agentic AI applications.
Without a doubt, data sovereignty requirements are an increasingly important factor as organizations seek to protect sensitive information from unauthorized access even when they process it on infrastructure operated by third parties. Although both Intel SGX and TDX are designed to protect sensitive information while it is being processed, they use substantially different approaches.
SGX provides hardware-protected enclaves within applications to isolate selected code and data from other software, including the operating system and hypervisor. By contrast, TDX isolates entire virtual machines from the underlying host environment, including the hypervisor and other VMs. While SGX requires developers to design or modify applications to use protected enclave…

Psychological safety is more than a culture initiative. In energy and infrastructure, it helps teams surface engineering risks, challenge assumptions and correct problems before costs escalate.
Some of the most significant organisational challenges in a high-growth workplace rarely stem from a lack of technical capability. It begins with a silent choice: an engineer noticing a structural flaw during design review but choosing not to push back; a manager realising a commissioning timeline is no longer viable yet absorbing the pressure rather than escalating the risk; a junior team member withholding a critical operational insight because the perceived cost of speaking up outweighs the comfort of remaining quiet.
On the surface, everything appears on track. The project milestone stays green on the executive dashboard, the meeting ends on schedule, and the targets remain unchanged. Yet, somewhere within the organisation, valuable information may not be flowing as effectively as it could.
This is the hard operational reality of psychological safety.
It is neither an employee perk nor a shift toward softer management. In large-scale energy and infrastructure workplaces, psychological safety is core risk management. It is the organisational capacity to surface uncomfortable truths early, before they compound into systemic failures.

Applied Materials bets $5 billion that bringing more of the industry’s R&D activities together will help it win that race.

Quizás lleve una discreta rosa en el antebrazo, como Ayuso, o un diseño que le cubre el cuello a lo Sergio Ramos. No importa.
En general y según un estudio de Lutronic PBS, el 42% de los españoles lucen al menos un tatto, lo que nos convierte en el sexto país más marcado por la tinta.

El teléfono afectado deja de recibir señal de AT&T, de forma intermitente en algunos casos y permanente en otros. En la barra de estado, donde deberían aparecer las barras de señal, se muestra la leyenda “SOS”.
La falla impide hacer y recibir llamadas, enviar mensajes de texto y usar datos móviles. Según AT&T, también puede afectar las llamadas al número de emergencias 911.
Cuando un iPhone 18 Pro Max de AT&T deja de tener señal y muestra “SOS” en la pantalla, se trata de una falla de conectividad que Apple confirmó el 2 de octubre de 2026. Jev-like decision models are flooding the AI market, after researcher claims TypeSafe copied their research — Microsoft, OpenAI among companies releasing lightweight 'System One' AI models
Round and round the AI world goes.
Following the release of TypeSafe's Jev, many AI players have launched competitors, and many similar open-source projects from the likes of Microsoft, OpenAI, and many more have since emerged. Yet Nandakishor Mukkunnoth, of ConvAI Innovations, said that he'd come up with the base notions for Jev's architecture over a year before. So who copied who?
As a quick recap, Jev and its clones are APIs driven by decision models, for use in your own code. You feed them input data like a customer's online shopping transactions, alongside questions. For example: "is the user looking for a return?" for a yes/no answer, and "Which item are they referring to?" with a multiple-choice answer. A Jev-like AI model will answer each of the questions or choices with a probability that can then be used in your own "if" statements. While the concept by itself isn't strictly new, this practical application is indeed novel.
The release made a good portion of the internet abuzz, as the seemingly simple concept is extremely useful and neatly sidesteps the usual problems with trying to coax an LLM into giving a direct answer. Sur les sites de torrents, le nom d’un fichier ne garantit pas toujours que son contenu corresponde réellement à ce qui est annoncé. C’est précisément ce que cherche à vérifier TorrentClaw, un moteur de recherche lancé en février 2026 et dont l’index dépasse désormais les six millions de torrents.

Les fichiers suspects peuvent ensuite être confrontés à VirusTotal.
34 malwares confirmés, dont 31 avec le même piège

Dieser Krypto-Grundsatz ist derzeit allerdings ordentlich ins Wanken geraten. Denn ausgerechnet Hardware-Wallets des bekannten Anbieters Ledger scheinen ein Sicherheitsproblem zu haben. Ersten Erkenntnissen zufolge befand sich in mindestens einem untersuchten Gerät eine Hardware-Erweiterung, die wohl die beim Einrichten angezeigte Seed-Phrase abfangen konnte. Diese privaten Schlüssel dienen der Wiederherstellung des Zugangs zur Wallet – und öffnen Angreifer:innen das Tor zu den darauf verwahrten Kryptowährungen.

Intel's Crescent Island AI accelerator officially powers new GPU D-Series products — chip delivers 1.3 peak PFLOPS of FP8 compute and 1.5 TB/s of memory bandwidth
Crescent Island gets official performance and bandwidth specs at OCP 2026.
At OCP 2026 today, Intel has given Crescent Island a proper name: the Intel GPU D-Series. For the first time, the company also shared a theoretical peak performance target for the chip: 1.3 PFLOPS of FP8. It also disclosed the final memory bandwidth to expect from these AI inference accelerators: 1.5 TB/s. This new information adds to the slow drip of disclosures Intel has made about Crescent Island throughout 2026.
We already knew that Crescent Island is the first chip to be built on Intel's Xe3P graphics architecture (or massively parallel computing architecture, really, as the chip lacks most or all of the graphics-specific functional units that would characterize a true GPU). Intel will release GPU D-Series products in an air-cooled PCIe form factor with a TDP of 350W and up to 480GB of LPDDR5X memory.
For reference, each of the 72 Rubin GPUs in Nvidia's Vera Rubin NVL72 rack-scale system can push a theoretical 17.5 PFLOPS of FP8 throughput, but each of those chips requires liquid cooling and likely has a TGP measured in kilowatts. In any event, it should be clear that the GPU D-Series is targeting an entirely different performance envelope and infrastructure requirements than Rubin.

articles.title: E-commerce AI startup Loops raises $3.5M to create smoother online shopping experiences - SiliconANGLE
articles.summary:
E-commerce AI startup Loops raises $3.5M to create smoother online shopping experiences
Agentic e-commerce startup Loops Smart AI wants to help online retailers create more seamless buying journeys and streamline the shopping experience after raising $3.5 million in seed funding today.
Andreessen Horowitz’s a16z speedrun accelerator led the round, with NTT Docomo, Connecticut Innovations, Alumni Ventures and Monday Capital all participating.
These days, most online retailers have adopted artificial intelligence tools in some way or another, but the way they’re doing it, by adding one feature at a time, is the wrong way to go about it, said Loops co-founder and Chief Executive Ari Nazir (pictured, left). All it leads to, he says, is fragmentation and disconnected experiences.
For instance, a retailer might add one AI tool to help with product searches, and a separate chatbot for answering customer’s questions, then another for generating product descriptions, followed by another to enable virtual try-ons. Nazir said these AI tools are all useful on their own, but the problem is they’re running in siloes, so they only understand a small piece of the overall customer journey. This means retailers have to find a way to stitch them altogether if they want to be more helpful and actually surface the ideal product for each customer.
Nazir said he and his co-founder İlker Selim Zorluoğlu (right) experienced this disconnect for themselves while on vacation in Bali a couple of years ag…

articles.title: Box-office : énorme flop pour la suite de The Social Network, Resident Evil bat un record
articles.summary:
Box-office : énorme flop pour la suite de The Social Network, Resident Evil bat un record
The Social Reckoning a fait un bide de taille pour son lancement au box-office américain ce week-end, alors que Jessica Chastain et le film d'horreur Malfaisante s'arrogent la couronne.
Si The Social Network a marqué les esprits et l'histoire du cinéma, on ne peut pas dire la même chose de sa suite officieuse The Social Reckoning, qui n'a pas rameuté les foules pour son lancement américain ce week-end. On fait le point.
Mark Zuckerberg et Facebook ne font pas recettes
Le long-métrage d'Aaron Sorkin s'est fait largement distancé par l'autre nouveauté de la semaine, le film d'horreur Malfaisante avec Jessica Chastain. Ce dernier décroche la première place du classement ce week-end avec 27,5 millions de dollars engrangés, et ce malgré des critiques et des retours publics désastreux.
Malfaisante devrait ainsi s'écrouler en deuxième semaine, mais ce démarrage est largement suffisant pour cette production Blumhouse/Atomic Monster (The Conjuring, Insidious, Backrooms) au budget de seulement 19 millions de dollars, d'autant que le film marche a fait l'essentiel à l'international.
Mais l'un des événements de la semaine est le bon maintien du dernier film Resident Evil, qui engrange encore 8,3 millions de dollars pour son quatrième week-end. Le long-métrage de Zach Cregger émarge à 138,5 millions sur le sol américain, et bat surtout un record pour la série dans le monde.

articles.title: Amazon planea comprar Decart por 7.000 millones dólares, la startup que Nvidia quería
articles.summary:
Amazon negocia la compra de la empresa Decart por unos USD 7.000 millones, según informó el diario The Wall Street Journal. El acuerdo podría cerrarse en los próximos días, aunque las negociaciones todavía pueden romperse.
Decart desarrolla un software que permite a los modelos de inteligencia artificial correr de forma más eficiente en distintos tipos de procesadores, sin depender de un solo fabricante de chips. La compañía, fundada en 2023 por los hermanos Dean y Orian Leitersdorf junto con Moshe Shalev, también desarrolla modelos de IA que generan video y entornos virtuales en tiempo real, como Lucy y Oasis.
Ninguna de las dos empresas confirmó públicamente la negociación. La cifra reportada representa un salto marcado frente a los USD 4.000 millones en los que se valuó a Decart en mayo, cuando la startup levantó USD 300 millones en una ronda liderada por Radical Ventures, con participación de Nvidia Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Sequoia Capital y Benchmark.
Nvidia y Anthropic ya habían intentado comprar Decart

articles.title: Creíamos que el plomo llegó a la península Ibérica con los fenicios, pero una aldea de Lleida ya lo fundía casi mil años antes
articles.summary:
Desde que la humanidad aprendió a sacar metales de las piedras, casi siempre la historia de la metalurgia ha ido de la mano del cobre y del bronce. Pues bien, hoy sabemos que sus orígenes fueron más dispares de lo que pensábamos. Es el caso del plomo, uno de los grandes olvidados. En la península Ibérica, la versión clásica lo asociaba a los fenicios, que llegaron hacia el año 1000 a.C., como recuerda la Universidad de Granada. Y bueno, sí y no: en un poblado de Lleida han aparecido trozos de plomo producidos allí mucho, mucho antes.
El hallazgo. Aparecieron en Minferri, un poblado de la Edad del Bronce en Juneda (Lleida), y eran tres fragmentos de escoria de entre 10 y 24 gramos que constituyen la prueba directa más antigua de fundición de plomo en Iberia. Para datarlos, el equipo de investigación analizó una semilla de trigo carbonizada hallada en el mismo silo que uno de los fragmentos, y su radiocarbono la sitúa entre el 1885 y el 1692 a. C.
Los otros dos fragmentos proceden de un pozo del mismo yacimiento, ocupado entre el 2100 y el 1600 a. C. aproximadamente. La producción se situaría, por tanto, hacia el 1900-1700 a. C., unos 700 a 900 años antes de la llegada de los fenicios.
Por qué importa. Porque cambia el quién y el cuándo. Hasta ahora se creía que el plomo ibérico llegó con los fenicios, que lo obtenían como subproducto de la plata. El estudio, liderado por la Universidad de Granada con Cambridge, la Universidad de Lleida e Iltirta Arqueología, describe en cambio…

articles.title: Why small businesses can’t afford to treat cybersecurity as an afterthought
articles.summary:
Why small businesses can’t afford to treat cybersecurity as an afterthought
Bitdefender Ultimate Small Business Security could be the cybersecurity co-worker to help you succeed
For a growing small business, cybersecurity can often feel like one of those problems that belongs to larger companies with dedicated security teams.
But cybercriminals have no interest in company headcount - they are hunting for valuable data, accessible accounts and opportunities to turn a single mistake into a financial payoff, which makes cybersecurity a business priority, not simply an IT concern.
The risks will hopefully sound familiar: phishing emails, fake invoices, stolen passwords, ransomware, payment fraud and attempts to hijack business accounts, as attackers look to exploit employees and everyday business processes rather than needing to defeat sophisticated technical defences.
AI is giving cybercrime a serious productivity boost
But now there is an additional force making these threats harder to ignore: artificial intelligence.
Generative AI has obvious benefits for legitimate businesses, but the same capabilities can be turned against them, as criminals can use AI to produce convincing messages at scale, personalise phishing attempts and automate parts of an attack that previously required significant manual effort.
Europol has warned that generative AI is already being used to supercharge social engineering, enabling criminals to tailor scam messages to victims' personal and cultural c…

articles.title: Google Traduction veut faire le ménage dans nos hésitations orales
articles.summary:
Parler naturellement est souvent bien plus chaotique qu’on ne l’imagine : tics de langage, bafouillages et retours en arrière ponctuent nos phrases au quotidien. Si un interlocuteur humain filtre ces parasites sans difficulté, les algorithmes de traduction automatique, eux, s’y heurtent régulièrement de plein fouet, rendant la traduction inopérante. Pour résoudre ce problème récurrent, Google s’apprête à doter son application Google Traduction d’un filtre intelligent capable d’épurer la parole avant de la traduire.
Repérée par le site Android Authority à travers la dissection du code de la dernière version Android (v10.39), cette nouveauté porte le nom de « Smart assist ». Son rôle : servir de sas de nettoyage entre la saisie vocale et le moteur de traduction. L’application proposerait ainsi deux approches distinctes. D’un côté, une transcription strictement littérale, fidèle à chaque syllabe prononcée ; de l’autre, ce mode intelligent chargé de corriger les faux départs et d’évacuer les bruits parasites (les fameux « heu », répétitions inutiles, voire les retours en arrière de type « ah non je ne voulais pas dire ça, je voulais dire… ») afin de transmettre un texte limpide et exploitable au moteur linguistique.
L’idée n’émerge pas de nulle part. Google transpose ici le savoir-faire acquis avec « Rambler », un module analogue inauguré sur son clavier virtuel Gboard pour soigner la dictée vocale.

articles.title: Mistlabs takes its Ambi AI system out of beta on Apple devices with $26M in funding - SiliconANGLE
articles.summary:
Mistlabs takes its Ambi AI system out of beta on Apple devices with $26M in funding
Ambient intelligence startup Mistlabs Ltd. today brought its Ambi artificial intelligence system out of beta test on Apple Inc. devices, backed by $26 million in new funding.
Ambi is designed to act without being asked. Chief Executive Peter Mo said most AI platforms are built to complete tasks, and Mistlabs wants to see what becomes possible once software can “understand, reason and act in real time.” Ambi’s actions can sometimes come “before the user even thinks to ask,” he said.
To do that, Ambi learns about a person from the conversations it hears on their iPhone, Apple Watch or Mac, and Mistlabs said the software’s read on how that person likes to work sharpens over time. None of it is locked to a single device. Whatever Ambi is in the middle of follows the user from the Mac to the phone or watch.
A user who sets up a Routine hands a recurring job to several agents at once, and those agents work from everything Ambi has picked up about that person. In one example the company gives, someone sits through a meeting about competitors while the agents fact-check what is being said as the discussion unfolds. Ambi may have compared the rival products and drafted a proposal on the user’s MacBook before anyone leaves the room. The agents keep at it once the meeting ends, flagging missing information or new developments as the project moves along.

articles.title: L’étrange paradoxe : comment une IA chinoise d’Alibaba permet à Microsoft de casser ses prix
articles.summary:
Avec Microsoft-Decision-1, le géant américain veut réduire le coût des petits arbitrages qui font tourner les applications. Ce modèle bâti sur une IA chinoise vise les développeurs et les entreprises qui cherchent à automatiser le tri, la vérification ou l’orientation des demandes.
La nouvelle IA de décision de Microsoft a des fondations chinoises. Présenté le 9 octobre, Microsoft-Decision-1 repose sur Qwen3.5-9B, un modèle de 9 milliards de paramètres développé par Alibaba, auquel les équipes de Redmond ont appliqué un entraînement spécialisé. L’outil est disponible préversion publique dans Microsoft Foundry et sur OpenRouter.
Ce qui étonne dans ce choix, c’est qu’OpenAI, le partenaire historique de Microsoft dans l’intelligence artificielle, propose déjà une API Decisions pour ces mêmes usages. Redmond a pourtant construit son propre modèle sur Qwen, tout en prévoyant des déclinaisons sur ses modèles MAI et ceux d’OpenAI.
À quoi sert une IA qui ne rédige rien ?
Prenons l’exemple d’une demande qui arrive à un service client. Faut-il l’envoyer à la facturation, à l’assistance technique ou au service commercial ? Le logiciel transmet le message et les options au modèle qui attribue une probabilité à chacune. L’application peut alors aiguiller la demande ou solliciter un humain si le résultat est trop incertain.
Ce fonctionnement intéresse les éditeurs de logiciels, les équipes informatiques et les entreprises qui développent des agents IA. Il peut servir à choisir le bon outil…

articles.title: GlobalFoundries Returns to Advanced-Node Race With 7 nm-Class FDX Fusion
articles.summary:
Monday, October 12th 2026
GlobalFoundries Returns to Advanced-Node Race With 7 nm-Class FDX Fusion
Back in the now distant 2018, the semiconductor industry had three major players in contract leading-edge node manufacturing: TSMC, Samsung, and GlobalFoundries. At that time, Intel did not accept external clients. However, as node design became increasingly expensive—requiring multi-billion dollar investments—and more complex, with many players encountering yield and manufacturing difficulties, GlobalFoundries announced that it was stopping its 7 nm node development indefinitely. This left only two companies in the leading-edge race, but GlobalFoundries continued to develop unique semiconductor solutions that did not focus on smaller transistor sizes.
Today, the company is back at a similar stopping point but with a unique solution called FDX Fusion, based on fully-depleted silicon-on-insulator (FD-SOI) technology. Unlike traditional CMOS, GlobalFoundries takes substrate isolation a step further by creating a fully insulating layer beneath the channel. This enables highly specialized capabilities, such as ultra-low-power in-memory computing, seamless integration of embedded non-volatile memory (like eMRAM), and highly efficient dense logic designs. With FDX Fusion, GlobalFoundries claims 7 nm-class node characteristics in terms of size and twice the transistor density of the first-generation 22FDX node, which was designated as a 22 nm-class design.For manufacturing, GlobalFound…

articles.title: El FBI arrestó a un sospechoso vinculado a las filtraciones de GTA 6
articles.summary:
El FBI arrestó a un ciudadano canadiense señalado como posible cómplice de una intrusión vinculada con las filtraciones de GTA 6 y GTA Online, según un reporte publicado por The New York Times. El caso vuelve a poner el foco sobre ShinyHunters, un grupo de hackers al que se atribuyen accesos no autorizados a información de Rockstar Games.
La relevancia del arresto está ligada a la cercanía del lanzamiento de Grand Theft Auto VI, uno de los videojuegos más esperados del mercado. Las filtraciones han expuesto datos sobre la compañía, GTA Online y una versión preliminar del proyecto, mientras la comunidad sigue cada novedad sobre una entrega que llegará el 19 de noviembre a PlayStation 5 y Xbox Series.
El arresto no confirma la participación directa en el hackeo
La información disponible identifica al detenido como un ciudadano canadiense al que se considera un “cómplice principal en la ejecución de la intrusión”. Sin embargo, el reporte no confirma de forma definitiva que haya participado en el ataque contra Rockstar Games ni que sea uno de los principales integrantes de ShinyHunters.
El sospechoso podría haber tenido un papel relevante en las actividades del grupo, responsable de filtraciones vinculadas con GTA 6 y GTA Online durante los últimos meses. La atribución concreta de cada ataque y la relación del detenido con las operaciones contra la empresa todavía requieren confirmación.

articles.title: Un ciberataque pone patas arriba los frigoríficos de supermercados franceses y otro incidente afecta a cadenas europeas
articles.summary:
Cuando pensamos en ciberseguridad, es fácil imaginar un correo sospechoso, una contraseña robada o una página web que deja de funcionar. Pero los sistemas informáticos también intervienen en actividades que no asociamos de inmediato con una pantalla, como conservar alimentos a la temperatura adecuada. En un supermercado, parte de esa tarea depende de dispositivos electrónicos que supervisan y gestionan los equipos de refrigeración. Nos hemos acostumbrado tanto a que funcionen que rara vez reparamos en ellos. Hasta que la posibilidad de manipularlos nos obliga a mirar de otra manera algo tan cotidiano como abrir un frigorífico.

articles.title: La prochaine Apple TV 4K pourrait bien vous faire oublier sa télécommande
articles.summary:
Apple prépare une nouvelle version de son Apple TV 4K, et quelques surprises pourraient accompagner son lancement. Le constructeur aurait notamment prévu deux nouveautés pour simplifier son utilisation au quotidien.
L’Apple TV 4K commence à se faire vieille. Lancé en 2022, le boîtier multimédia d’Apple n’a pas connu de nouvelle version depuis quatre ans, une éternité dans le monde de la tech. Son successeur est attendu dans les prochains jours, à l’occasion d’un événement consacré à la maison connectée. On savait déjà que le constructeur préparait une nouvelle puce, ainsi que l’arrivée de Siri AI, mais deux autres nouveautés pourraient être de la partie. Et pour une fois, elles ne concernent ni la puissance du processeur ni la qualité de l’image, mais des petits détails qui pourraient faire toute la différence au quotidien.
Siri pourrait enfin vous entendre depuis le canapé
Selon les informations de Mark Gurman, de Bloomberg, relayées par 9to5Mac, Apple aurait testé l’intégration de microphones directement dans sa prochaine Apple TV 4K. Le boîtier pourrait ainsi répondre aux commandes vocales sans passer par sa télécommande.
Aujourd'hui, pour demander à Siri de lancer une série ou d’éteindre les lumières du salon, il faut attraper la Siri Remote et maintenir son bouton dédié. Rien de bien compliqué, mais avec des microphones intégrés, une simple commande lancée depuis le canapé pourrait suffire.

Il avait fallu six mois pour assembler les 27 premiers, l’usine peut désormais en produire 27 par semaine. Mais seuls 396 volent, et ce compteur n’a pas bougé depuis début juillet.
Rajeev Badyal a expliqué être à « quelques semaines » d’un lancement sur Vulcan dans un échange avec Ars Technica. Le responsable, renvoyé par Elon Musk il y a huit ans, ajoute que cela sera suivi d’un vol Arianespace et d’au moins un autre Vulcan d’ici la fin de l’année.
Amazon a réparti ses lancements entre quatre fournisseurs (ULA, Blue Origin, Arianespace et SpaceX), et deux d’entre eux ont eu des ennuis. La fusée Vulcan d’ULA a été immobilisée par un défaut de tuyère, la pièce qui expulse les gaz du moteur, que Badyal dit aujourd’hui corrigé. Quant à New Glenn, la fusée de Blue Origin, elle a explosé sur son pas de tir en mai. Si le prochain lancement est attendu dans quelques semaines, Amazon ne s’engage que sur l’année pour le service lui-même.
« Le plan est de lancer le service initial en 2026 », explique Chris Weber, responsable de l’activité commerciale, en ajoutant qu’il reste à amener les satellites déjà en orbite à leur position finale.

articles.title: Nintendo Says Physical Switch 2 Games Are Here to Stay
articles.summary:
Monday, October 12th 2026
Nintendo Says Physical Switch 2 Games Are Here to Stay
Nintendo isn't following Sony toward a digital-only future, at least for now. Videocardz reports that Bill van Zyll, Nintendo's Vice President and General Manager for Latin America, said the company has no plans to drop physical games on the Switch 2. He spoke to Brazilian YouTube channel Coelho no Japão at Brasil Game Show (BGS) 2026, telling them that Nintendo goes by what customers prefer and that the Switch 2 supports both physical and digital releases. His exact words were: "There's no plans to ditch physical. We know how much the fans like it as well." Apparently, physical games are especially popular in Latin America, Brazil included. 
Nintendo's clarification is important, as Sony, on the other hand, confirmed in July that disc production for new PlayStation games will end in January 2028, although games released before then won't be affected. That decision drew plenty of backlash, and data from Alinea Analytics later showed discs still bring in a sizeable share of revenue for PlayStation's biggest exclusives. Nintendo's own numbers point toward digital dominance too, with 61.5% of its software sales coming from digital in the April to June quarter. The company has also been pricing digital Switch 2 exclusives lower than their physical versions since May. Of course, plans can change, though for the foreseeable future, cartridges seem safe on the Switch 2.

articles.title: Los neumáticos se tiran enteros cuando solo una parte está gastada. Unos investigadores españoles quieren cambiarlo con un diseño modular

Cambiar los neumáticos forma parte del mantenimiento habitual de un coche, y rara vez nos detenemos a pensar en qué estamos retirando exactamente. Lo que suele obligarnos a hacerlo es el desgaste de la banda de rodadura, esa superficie de caucho que pisa la carretera, pero bajo ella hay una estructura mucho mayor que no necesariamente ha llegado al final de su vida útil. La carcasa puede recuperarse en determinados casos mediante el recauchutado. La cuestión es por qué seguimos utilizando cubiertas que, por lo general, sustituimos completas cuando solo una parte ha llegado a su límite de desgaste.
La Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M) está ensayando una respuesta a esa pregunta. Su proyecto ECOTIRE propone un neumático concebido desde el principio para que la pieza sometida al mayor desgaste sea desmontable y pueda sustituirse sin desechar también la carcasa. Según explica el equipo, esa parte intercambiable representa menos del 20% del peso total, por lo que conservar el resto permitiría aprovechar una proporción considerable de los materiales. La idea ya se ha convertido en un prototipo físico, aunque sus resultados todavía pertenecen al terreno experimental y no al de los productos disponibles para los conductores.

articles.title: WhatsApp permet enfin de programmer l’envoi d’un message
articles.summary:
Vous pouvez officiellement programmer l’envoi d’un message dans WhatsApp. Enfin presque. L’application de messagerie instantanée vient de déployer, pour l’heure uniquement dans la version bêta de son application Android, une nouvelle option permettant de planifier l’envoi d’une missive.
Des messages programmés dans WhatsApp
Jusqu’à maintenant, WhatsApp n’embarquait aucune option permettant de planifier l’envoi d’un message. Seuls Google Messages et Apple Messages proposaient cette fonctionnalité. Mais la messagerie instantanée de Meta est sur le point de rattraper son retard.
Après avoir saisi un message dans le champ prévu à cet effet, un appui long sur le bouton d’envoi permet d’accéder au menu pour définir la date et l’heure d’envoi du message. La fonction, qui ne se limite pas aux seuls messages textes, prend également en charge l’envoi planifié de fichiers multimédias. Attention toutefois, chaque message programmé ne pourra comporter qu’un seul fichier (photo ou vidéo) à la fois.
La programmation des messages est par ailleurs soumise à d’autres restrictions. Vous devrez, par exemple, programmer l’envoi d’un message dans un délai minimum de dix minutes. Cette durée minimale requise par WhatsApp doit vous permettre d’avoir suffisamment de temps si vous devez corriger votre missive. Par ailleurs, vous ne pourrez pas programmer l’envoi d’un message au-delà de deux semaines à l’avance.

Un teléfono Android viejo puede convertirse en el cerebro de un robot humanoide gracias a un proyecto desarrollado por investigadores de la Universidad de California en Los Ángeles (UCLA), Estados Unidos.
El prototipo, bautizado como PhoneBot, demuestra que un smartphone de gama baja o incluso un modelo lanzado en 2017 puede controlar los movimientos de un robot bípedo, procesar su visión y mantener su equilibrio, sin necesidad de hardware costoso adicional.
Cómo el teléfono se convierte en el cerebro del robot
PhoneBot es un robot que utiliza un smartphone Android para interpretar su entorno y controlar su propio movimiento, sin depender de componentes electrónicos especializados y costosos. El teléfono se instala en posición vertical dentro del torso y cumple la función de cabeza.
Desde ahí asume casi todas las tareas de procesamiento. Su cámara detecta personas y permite que el robot las siga. Su unidad de medición inercial, compuesta por giroscopio y acelerómetro, registra la orientación del cuerpo y ayuda a mantener el equilibrio.
El procesador del propio celular ejecuta el modelo que controla las articulaciones, mientras que la pantalla permite consultar el estado del sistema. Ninguno de estos componentes tiene una conexión física con el chasis: todas las órdenes viajan por wifi hasta un pequeño ordenador instalado en el cuerpo del robot, encargado de accionar los motores.

Exclusive: Akuity adds Fleet Management to Kargo Enterprise to replace per-cluster pipelines
Software delivery platform company Akuity Inc. today added Fleet Management to its Kargo Enterprise platform to allow teams to ship one change across hundreds of Kubernetes clusters as a single release.
Akuity is pitching it as a replacement for the per-cluster pipelines those teams maintain now. The new capability goes after a delivery problem that gets worse each time a company adds infrastructure.
Production environments that once meant one cluster or 10 now often run to hundreds, according to Akuity, with artificial intelligence speeding up that growth. Every new cluster adds release risk and slows delivery, the company said.
Kargo Enterprise, which runs on the Akuity Platform, is the commercial edition of Kargo, the open-source promotion project Akuity created. With Fleet Management switched on, teams group their clusters into a fleet and set the rollout order and failure threshold one time.
Kargo then promotes each change through the fleet wave by wave. Every cluster reports its own health along the way, and platform teams watching the rollout can tell how far a release has gotten at any point.

articles.summary:
Microsoft debuts multichiplet Maia 300 inference accelerator
Microsoft Corp. today pulled back the curtains on Maia 300, its newest internally developed artificial intelligence accelerator.
The chip is optimized for inference, the process of generating responses to AI queries. Microsoft estimates that it can process 40% more tokens per megawatt than “leading GPU-based systems,” which is likely a reference to Nvidia Corp. products. The company said the Maia chip series will become its primary source of inference capacity over time.
Maia 300 features four computing chiplets made using Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.’s latest two-nanometer node. The chiplets are flanked by eight HBM4 modules with 288 gigabytes of combined capacity, the same amount as Nvidia Corp.’s flagship Rubin accelerator. However, Maia 300 has about 20% less memory bandwidth than Rubin. Memory bandwidth is a measure of how much fast data can be transferred to and from RAM.
AI chips usually perform inference by repeatedly shifting data between their computing and memory circuits. That constant movement slows down processing. According to Microsoft, Maia 300 features a dataflow architecture designed to minimize data movement. When possible, the computing chiplets keep information in an internal SRAM cache instead of sending it to the HBM stacks.
In situations where using HBM can’t be avoided, Maia 300’s computing chiplets send data to a memory stack that is physically nearby. That’s faster than transmit…

Van Zyll agregó que la compañía “también sabe cuánto les gustan a los fans” las copias físicas y remarcó que Nintendo Switch 2, lanzada hace poco más de un año, admite juegos tanto digitales como físicos.
Nintendo asegura que no dejará de vender juegos físicos porque buena parte de sus jugadores, sobre todo en América Latina, sigue prefiriendo las copias en caja antes que las descargas digitales, y la compañía dice guiarse por esas preferencias del consumidor antes que por una estrategia unificada con el resto de la industria.

articles.summary: Startup investment across the Middle East and North Africa more than doubled in the third quarter of 2026, driven by a wave of large Saudi fintech deals that helped revive funding activity despite persistent geopolitical uncertainty. Startups across MENA raised $1.65 billion through 145 deals between July and September, up 108% from the previous quarter , while deal volume increased 39%. AI is speeding up code production, but reviewing is the next bottleneck
- Lines of code, code commits and pull requests are all up 20-30%
- Comments per pull request are up 49% as human review becomes more crucial
- With reviewing up from 7 to 10 days on average, the new bottleneck is code review
A new Harvard University research paper has confirmed that AI is indeed excellent at boosting coding productivity, but humans just end up slowing the process back down anyway.
Authors Fiona Chen and James Stratton found a 30% increase in the amount of code developers can produce when using AI, but they found no statistically significant improvement in completed software.
With increases across lines of code produced (+30%), code commits (+20%) and pull requests (+23%), the Harvard-backed researchers went on to investigate why we're not seeing a 20-30% increase in end product.
AI has definitely sped up coding, but human delays negate much of those benefits
At the same time, the researchers also found increases across the time taken to review and merge pull requests (+49%), the number of reviewer comments per pull request (+35%) and even the proportion of employees doing code reviews (+14%), all of which implying that vibe coding is ultimately shifting the bottleneck further down the road instead of removing it altogether.

articles.title: Por qué el televisor tiene una luz roja parpadeando y qué problema está avisando
articles.summary:
La luz roja del televisor no es un simple testigo decorativo. En los televisores inteligentes de marcas como Samsung, LG, Sony, TCL, Hisense y Philips, ese pequeño punto en el borde inferior forma parte de un sistema de diagnóstico que informa sobre el estado del equipo incluso cuando la pantalla permanece apagada.
Cuando el televisor está desconectado de la pantalla pero sigue enchufado, la luz roja fija indica que el aparato se encuentra en modo de espera (standby), listo para encenderse de inmediato con el control remoto. Ese comportamiento es normal y no representa ninguna falla. Algo diferente cuando parpadea.
Qué significa que la luz roja del TV parpadee
El problema aparece cuando esa luz, en lugar de permanecer fija, comienza a parpadear de forma intermitente con el televisor apagado. Según explica Samsung, este parpadeo puede señalar un inconveniente en la alimentación eléctrica o en algún componente interno del equipo.
No implica necesariamente una avería grave, pero sí advierte que algo no funciona como debería. En algunas marcas, como Sony, el número de destellos consecutivos actúa como un código de diagnóstico: cada secuencia de parpadeos corresponde a un tipo de error distinto que el servicio técnico utiliza para localizar la falla.

- US Army awarded $4.15 billion in counter-drone contracts to 10 companies
- Seven of the ten winners each received a $500 million base award
- The framework carries a maximum ceiling of $7 billion across all awards
The US Army has awarded contracts worth $4.15 billion to 10 companies developing technologies against cheap drones threatening military installations and critical infrastructure across the country.
The awards fall under Domestic Shield, a Department of Defense initiative intended to strengthen protection against unmanned aircraft without restricting procurement to individual suppliers.
Seven companies will receive $500 million each, while three others secured smaller awards, establishing a multi-vendor arrangement with a maximum value of $7 billion.
Ten suppliers share billions in counter-drone contracts
Allen Control Systems, Digital Force Technologies, DroneShield, L3Harris WESCAM, Napatree Technology, RADA Technologies and SRC each received contracts with $500 million base values under the initiative.
Echodyne and PVP Advanced EO Systems secured awards worth $250 million apiece, while Smart Shooter received a contract valued at $150 million.
